name: WisCon
organizer: SF3 (Society for the Furtherance and Study of Fantasy and Science Fiction)
blurb: A feminist, inclusive science fiction and fantasy convention held over Memorial Day weekend in Madison, Wisconsin; hybrid online and in-person for 2027.

editions.evidence: Homepage: 'WISCON 2027 May 27 to May 31, 2027 (U.S. Memorial Day Weekend)' and 'we will be online and in-person at the Concourse Hotel.'

notes: The only guest-related post so far ('Expanded Slate - Four Guests of Honor for 2027', Sept 30 2026) confirms there will be four GoH but explicitly defers naming them: 'Look forward to an announcement of the full slate soon.' No names or photos exist yet, so guests is none-yet. Organizer SF3 inferred from the post's mention of 'the annual SF3 general meeting' (WisCon's long-standing parent nonprofit).
